annotations.text: Round 1. Start with the cover: why nine rounds produced no pick, the floor decided from the owner's own reads, the three directions, the same boat in three hands, the side-by-side, the recommendation and the one call (H-87). Then the three boards in a row — each redraws the same six screens for Blue Mantis on Thursday, August 27 at 6:40 AM.
A · Inset: the group carries the page. B · Glass: the material carries the page. C · Figures: the number carries the page, on Inset's lists and shell. Recommended: C.

Round 2, drawn on the owner's read of round 1 ("the core of this design is kind of ugly; evaluate the visuals themselves; nicer, more Apple-like solutions"): the cover evaluates round 1's own pixels and decides the surface — cool neutrals, one DiveDay blue, the device's face, capsules, re-cut icons, an iPhone around every pocket frame, black at night — and the three boards beside it are round 1's three redrawn frame for frame on it. The call is unchanged: H-87, A, B or C.
